name: ai-research-skills
description: Researcher-facing Claude Code skills for Zotero, Obsidian, NotebookLM, research memory, and paper workflows.

metadata.description: Catalog of AI skills for the research workflow — researcher-led, AI-assisted

plugins.name: research-workspace
plugins.description: 12 research-hub skills: a resumable human-in-the-loop workflow orchestrator plus literature search, comparison, orientation, context compression, design, verified multi-agent routing, NotebookLM verification, paper memory and summaries, Zotero curation, and gap-to-topic decisions.

plugins.name: academic-writing-skills
plugins.description: Lifecycle-aware manuscript development and general scientific review with progressively loaded display provenance, psychometrics, AI/LLM, water, flood, round, and optional reviewer modules.

plugins.name: zotero-skills
plugins.description: Full Zotero CRUD: search, add, update, tag, trash/restore, delete, merge duplicates, and attach PDFs via pyzotero. Dual local/Web API routing; writes work even when the separately configured zotero MCP server is read-only.

plugins.name: codex-delegate
plugins.description: Minimal synchronous Codex CLI adapter for legacy on-disk briefs, result/sentinel contracts and Bash/PowerShell portability; supervisor scope/test acceptance remains required.

plugins.name: antigravity-delegate
plugins.description: Bounded cheap-executor lane for non-honesty-critical mechanical edits through Google Antigravity CLI, with brief-first scope and result verification.
